text: Polestar Automotive Holding UK PLC's 20-F for 2025 lists Li Shufu as the largest holder with 79,981,976 ADSs, 55.2% of outstanding shares (through PSD Investment Limited, Snita and Geely vehicles), and states that PSD Investment Limited controls approximately 27.9% of the total voting power and that PSD Investment Limited, Snita and affiliates of Geely together beneficially hold approximately 52.9% of the outstanding voting power. Volvo Cars' shareholding is approximately 19.9% and Geely Sweden Automotive Investment B.V. holds approximately 11.6%. Li Shufu directly or indirectly owns approximately 91.9% of Geely, which owns approximately 78.7% of Volvo Cars. As of December 31, 2025, related parties owned 69.0% of the Group. No state or state fund is named among the five-percent-or-more holders.
short: Polestar 20-F: Li Shufu 55.2% of shares, PSD 27.9% of votes, Geely group 52.9% of voting power; no state holder listed.
